INSTITUTE       FACULTY OF SCIENCE
PROGRAM       MASTER OF SCIENCE (MICROBIOLOGY)
SEMESTER         3
COURSE TITLE    EFFECTIVE COMMUNICATION SKILLS - I
COURSE CODE     02SL0401
COURSE CREDITS  3

Objective:
 1  The course aims at enhancing proficiency of the learners in expressing their ideas in
     various contexts. The course also deals with varied nuances of presentation skills to enable
     learners to make effective presentations. The Course will include different interactive
      activities on diverse aspects of spoken communication through experiential learning.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Develop speaking skill in the context of science
 2  Enhance presentation skills in the context of science
 3  Express ideas in an organized way for different communication situations
 4  Demonstrate adequate command over language in a spoken form
 5  Develop speaking skill in the context of science


Pre-requisite of course:The course aims at enhancing proficiency of the learners in expressing
their ideas in various contexts. The course also deals with varied nuances of presentation skills
to enable learners to make effective presentations. The Course will include different interactive
activities on diverse aspects of spoken communication through experiential learning.

INSTITUTE       FACULTY OF SCIENCE
PROGRAM       MASTER OF SCIENCE (MICROBIOLOGY)
SEMESTER         1
COURSE TITLE    MICROBIAL EVOLUTION AND PHYLOGENETICS
COURSE CODE     02MB0408
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To impart knowledge about concepts of origin of microbial life and it’s divergence in
     different families.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Understand the evolution and classification of life forms, Diversity and nomenclature of
    microorganism.
 2  State approach of to construct Phylogenetic trees and its Algorithms
 3  Develop and analyze different methods for determining evolutionary relationships among
    microorganisms
 4  Develop an understanding of Microbial Diversity and economical importance of the
     organisms.


Pre-requisite of course:N.A.
